note: Captured from the CHR test router through the API, as the Packet Sniffer page runs a capture: /tool/sniffer/set then start, then the tables read while it ran. The protocol table nests - a row per MAC protocol, a row per IP protocol under it, a row per port under that - and only the top-level rows partition the capture. The packet list holds fewer packets than the totals because the router's memory buffer drops the oldest; it is trimmed here to its newest 120 rows, which is the same shape a smaller memory-limit produces. `data`, the per-packet hex dump, was never read. Addresses scrubbed into TEST-NET-2 and 2001:db8::/32, MACs into 02:, ports and interface names kept. RouterOS 7.24.4.
